dex.entry: A medium bark-golem that moves with deliberate slowness. Its bark-ring shell has mineralised completely, giving it near-impenetrable defences. The middle of a great defensive line — growing visibly stronger while staying unhurried and serene.

art.silhouette: Stocky upright tortoise-golem, concentric mineral-bark rings clearly visible on shell, mossy patches on flat back, two large stone-knuckled fists, calm half-lidded eyes.
